_comment: Entities to research, one per strain or product. Consumer-available preparations only, live and non-viable alike; every entity carries preparation: live | non_viable. Identity lives HERE and nowhere else - a strain shard carries strain_id and joins the rest from this file. roster_source records which sweep and which source put each entity on the list, so a re-run of the sweeps is a diff rather than a re-derivation. Rebuilt by the sweeps described in SCHEMA.md (Roster assembly), not hand-maintained. See _assembly below for what was and was not swept.

_assembly.method: Two sweeps, union taken. Sweep A enumerated source lists; Sweep B harvested strains from the most recent systematic review per in-scope clinical outcome.
sweep_a_sources: AEProbio Clinical Guide to Probiotic Products, USA 10th ed. 2024 (product tables)
AEProbio Clinical Guide to Probiotic Products, Canada 18th ed. 2026 (product tables)
AEProbio Clinical Guide to Probiotic Products, UK current ed.
WGO Global Guidelines: Probiotics and Prebiotics 2023, Tables 8 and 9
Targeted Japan pass: Meiji, Morinaga, Megmilk Snow Brand, Kirin, Asahi, Kagome
_assembly.sweep_a_not_swept: Health Canada NHPID monograph as a standalone document (the Canadian AEProbio edition marks Health-Canada-approved indications inline, covering most of its value); EFSA QPS list; FDA GRAS notices; manufacturer catalogues beyond the Japanese majors. Stated rather than left implicit — these are known open edges, not assumed coverage.
_assembly.sweep_b_outcomes_covered: AAD/CDI, IBS (global/pain/bloating), constipation, infant colic, NEC, H. pylori, UC/pouchitis, URTI/immune, glycemic control, NAFLD, lipids, body weight/visceral fat, depression/anxiety/stress/sleep, safety.
_assembly.sweep_b_outcomes_not_covered: None. All 63 in-scope outcome IDs have now been swept (the 14 Mechanistic IDs deliberately excluded per the method above - mechanistic evidence alone cannot satisfy criterion 3).
_assembly.sweep_b_limitation: Most systematic reviews pool at genus or species level rather than by strain, so Sweep B yielded far fewer named strains than expected for NEC, URTI, H. pylori, UC, and mental health. The strain-specific IBS review was the outlier and the richest single source. Sweep A therefore carried more of the load than the method predicted.
_assembly.scope_decision_non_viable: RESOLVED: non-viable preparations are IN scope. By the ISAPP definition a probiotic is a live microorganism, so heat-killed, heat-inactivated and pasteurized preparations are postbiotics rather than probiotics; they are included anyway and carry preparation: non_viable. Reasoning is in the Scope section of SCHEMA.md. The gap this created has been CLOSED by sweep_c_non_viable below. One consequence worth knowing: preparation turned out to be part of ENTITY IDENTITY, not an annotation on it - B. bifidum MIMBb75 exists on the roster twice, live and heat-inactivated, because they are different products with different trials, and merging them would attribute the Lancet heat-inactivated result to the live strain.
_assembly.sweep_c_non_viable: Targeted sweep for non-viable preparations, run after the scope decision. Sources: the three AEProbio editions and WGO 2023 already in hand, plus a manufacturer/literature pass over the Japanese majors (Asahi/Calpis, Morinaga, House Wellness, Sapporo, Kirin, Combi, Bio-Lab), Synformulas/Kijimea, Bened, Chr. Hansen and Maypro. FINDING: the AEProbio guides contain ZERO heat-killed, inactivated, pasteurized or postbiotic entries - they are probiotic-only by construction, which is exactly why the original Sweep A found none of this and why the gap was structural rather than an oversight. WGO 2023 does carry heat-inactivated MIMBb75, in the same Table 8 row as the live strain. 12 entities added; lactobacillus-gasseri-cp2305 corrected from live to non_viable.
_assembly.sweep_b_second_pass: The 12 previously uncovered outcome IDs were swept: travelers' diarrhea, lactose intolerance, SIBO, hepatic encephalopathy, radiation/chemo diarrhea, Crohn's maintenance, VAP, infant sepsis, vaccine response, blood pressure, gestational diabetes, autism. Yield: ONE new entity (lacticaseibacillus-paracasei-431, from the vaccine-response literature) plus two exclusions. Every other named strain was already on the roster: S. boulardii CNCM I-745, L. acidophilus DDS-1, LcS, VSL#3/Visbiome, LGG, B. clausii, BB-12, PS128. This is sweep_b_limitation again and more starkly - blood pressure, gestational diabetes, infant sepsis, Crohn's maintenance and radiation/chemo diarrhea reviews name NO strain designations at all, pooling at species or 'multi-strain'. Under tier rule 6 those pooled estimates are not evidence for any entity, so these outcomes may end up with few or no rows however much literature exists. NOTABLE CONFIRMATION: the lactose-intolerance meta-analysis attributes the effect to S. thermophilus and L. delbrueckii subsp. bulgaricus with no strain designations, independently confirming that species-live-yogurt-cultures needed to be a species_level entity.

entities.species: Lactobacillus delbrueckii subsp. bulgaricus + Streptococcus thermophilus
entities.known_for: lactose digestion in lactose maldigesters. The species is the right unit because the evidence base is itself species-defined: EFSA's approved Article 13.1 claim specifies yogurt containing at least 10^8 CFU/g of these two organisms, with no strain designation anywhere in the claim, and the 13 studies it rests on used ordinary commercial yogurt. Under rule 2 this evidence never transfers to a named bulgaricus or thermophilus strain, and no named strain's trial feeds this entity
entities.roster_source: A: EFSA Journal 2010;8(10):1763 (Article 13.1 claim, ID 1143, 2976). The only species-level entity on the roster; admitted under the species_level guard rule in SCHEMA.md

Admitted as a product rather than a strain because the evidence is product-defined by construction: every trial administers 500 mg of EpiCor, the designation is withheld commercially, and no other S. cerevisiae preparation reproduces the finding. Under tier rule 2 no EpiCor result may become an S. cerevisiae claim. Non-viable: a dried fermentate, an ISAPP postbiotic - triage should confirm the processing detail

_excluded_comment: Entities considered and ruled out, each with the criterion it failed. Keeps 'not yet considered' distinguishable from 'considered and excluded' so a later sweep does not re-propose them. Each carries a strain_id for the same reason the roster does: exclusions have to diff by key, not by free-text label. No strain_id may appear both here and in entities (validation rule 8).
